name: Blocked approach road
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. No live road-closure feed is used; the closure is authored.
selection_rule: lowest camp by DSM elevation; nearest non-bridge road within 500 m; a 200 m stretch at its midpoint
expected_effects: travel time increase for the affected shelter catchment
possible loss of access within the stated time budget
assertions: closure is respected by the router
the detour never uses a road tagged impassable
any access loss is flagged instead of being hidden by a longer route
